```jjscript
# State Machine Metamodel

# Core classes
create class State
create class Transition

# Specialized state types using inheritance
create class InitialState
create class ProcessingState
create class TerminalState

InitialState extends State
ProcessingState extends State
TerminalState extends State

# State attributes
create attribute value in State type String
create attribute errorLog in State type String

# Transition attributes
create attribute name in Transition type String
create attribute condition in Transition type String

# Relationships linking Transition to States
create reference source in Transition type State [1]
create reference target in Transition type State [1]
```
